A Solana activity index will be connected after the program is deployed for production use.
Actoria writes down who took part, how the room voted and where the money sits — a public register, stamped hour by hour, that anyone can reopen. No private minutes, no unlisted spreadsheet.
An open record cuts both ways
Anyone can reopen these reads, including people who disagree with the last decision.
Anything claiming a Actoria token right now is not from this project.
Create a proposal with a 1–30 day window, or vote on an open one. One vote per wallet. Results are advisory.
Each quest is an open invitation to take part. Recording one writes a single row for your wallet — it does not verify off-chain work, prove a unique person or pay a token.
Give wallets 1–30 days so the vote is not a reflex.
Independent community project · not affiliated with the Solana Foundation.
Is Actoria an official Solana product?

Preview means sample rows are shown and nothing is submitted. A connection error means configured Solana data could not be read — use the refresh button to retry. Never share a seed phrase or private key to fix a connection.
Quests and advisory votes run through the Solana program. Staking, locking and rewards stay switched off until a mint and its custody rules exist.
Quests appear here once the community publishes them.
Quests carry an expiry and a row cap. Each wallet records once. Rows do not verify off-chain work, prove a unique person, or pay a token.
Recording a quest row, publishing a proposal and casting a vote use the initialised program on

Rewards need money behind them. Until that exists, no reward can be promised in a row.
Rows marked “sample” are examples. They never send a transaction and disappear as soon as the program reads real data.
Rows record participation only. No token reward is attached.

The community program records participation and advisory votes. It never mints, holds or pays out a token.
The mint address, decimals and metadata would be read from Solana before any label appears here.
The program authority can publish quests and pause community actions. Advisory votes do not execute treasury spending.
The program is paused. Reads continue; transactions are unavailable.
The program records participation rows and advisory votes. It does not custody tokens, mint rewards or track staking positions.
Treasury balances and account rows are read straight from Solana. When a read is unavailable, this page says so instead of guessing.
Votes do not execute treasury spending. Weight follows the program's own rules.
